Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) at the unlock scan after `@objectstack/spec` **17.6.0** reached npm. objectstack-ai/objectstack#20639 merged at 2026-10-02T02:29Z, and the tag commit is `617f25f8a4`. The shape is objectui#11073's, the 17.5.0 bump. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why one card

objectui `origin/main`'s `pnpm-lock.yaml` still resolves `@objectstack/spec@17.5.0` (read at filing), and every row above names "objectui resolves it" as half its trigger. Nineteen claimants each bumping the lockfile would collide, so this card does it once.

## The change

- Update objectui's `@objectstack/*` dependencies to 17.6.0, and regenerate `pnpm-lock.yaml` with the repository's own tooling. ⛔ Never edit it by hand.
- Where a package will import a 17.6.0-only export, raise that package's declared floor (`^17.6.0`). The consuming card may do this instead: say which in the PR.
- Run the full gate set. 17.6.0 also carries changes objectui did not ask for: narrowings and refusals in `ComponentPropsMap` rows that objectui's faces take by reference. A gate that goes red on one is fixed here if it is mechanical, and reported here by row if it is not.

## After it lands

Each row above has its `Restart-when:` met. Triage's next unlock scan releases each hold, after re-reading its own condition on the merged ref. ⛔ No hold is released by this card's own act.
